b03_001_lifecycle_authority_registry.authority: Broker may create, progress, suspend, correct by supersession, terminate, and archive Broker-owned lifecycle records.
Trader owns execution intent; Broker may accept temporary custody for broker boundary processing.
Broker may consume and preserve references but shall not mutate or settle externally owned truth.
Broker owns evidence production; Historian owns preservation custody after transfer.
